items.title: هاري وميغان.. عودة إلى بريطانيا تهدد بإشعال صراع الألقاب الملكية

items.titleEn: Harry and Megan... Returning to Britain threatens to ignite a battle of royal titles.
items.summaryEn: Harry and Meghan's return to Britain raised questions about their relationship with the Royal Institution, amid fears of rivalry by members of the royal family in the limelight, and speculation of their possible stripping of their titles when Prince William takes the throne.

items.titleEn: Why are the air strikes on the Houthis in Taiz escalating? Three military experts answering .
items.summaryEn: Recently, airstrikes against the Houthis' positions, reinforcements, weapons and mechanisms in and around the besieged city of Taiz and its villages have escalated, in a development that military experts believe falls within the framework of multiple targets.

items.titleEn: The Knesset refuses to freeze the detention of recruitment smugglers.

items.title: الفضة تهبط 5.7% دون 40 دولارا للأونصة عقب صدور بيانات أمريكية

items.titleEn: Silver is down 5.7 percent below $40 an ounce after US data release.

items.titleEn: Leave the heater on while you sleep? Watch out for these dangers .

items.titleEn: Why do you forget more after 40? Hormones and memory are under the microscope.
